experimental_candidate.resume_contract: Complete Native plus World/environment; never snapshot/RAW/clocks alone.

blocks.coverage: completed / interrupted-preserved / not-run; use actual state

comparison.assistance: Prepared route/capability calls must remain explicit; Native content and external policy/model decisions are different sources.

load.scope: Focal Native owner load; not three Roblox characters unless actually demonstrated

continuation.before_resume: Verify complete pair, owner closure, ledger and resource exhaustion; do not automatically retry uncertain IDs.

continuity_document.scope: ZIP is analysis and reproducibility evidence, not an executable full-state backup; protected Manual remains local and unchanged.

omissions_document.selection_criterion: Keep full small decisive results and controls; omit duplicate transport envelopes, full state/dependencies and model weights. No adversarial result may be omitted because it is negative.

items.bytes_status: Use measured manifest sum if available; otherwise not measured, never invented
items.sha256_status: No folder hash; cite the existing member-manifest path and its actual SHA
items.why_omitted: Complete state preserved locally; exceeds transfer budget and is not replaced by the ZIP.
items.minimum_next_material: Complete contract-defined state plus official shared runtime; snapshot alone is insufficient

items.why_omitted: Shared large dependency or external comparator weights; exact model/runtime identification remains in included metadata.
items.needed_for: Comparator inference or Native execution, never passive recalc

items.why_omitted: Repeated SDK inventory/chunk envelopes; full actual World and selected action/ACK/function proofs retained.
INTEGRAL V2 protects these originals and does not require their transfer or modification.
items.minimum_next_material: Only needed if a subsequent authorized task requires operational continuation

omissions_document.secrets_and_unrelated_projects: Excluded; no credential contents or unrelated paths copied
